attribution_boundary.CE_MSE: Same-capacity same-J fixed-beta/fixed-hyperparameter loss-form intervention with matching recorded random exposures; losses/gradients differ, so beta1 does not match effective KL weight. No universal categorical-vs-MSE or tuned-MSE claim. Each DDPM is downstream of its own trained representation.
attribution_boundary.scalar: Whole-pipeline fresh legacy adaptation; different head, numeric target, all48 squared-error numerator/nonPAD denominator, density/16 and native round-clamp-firstPAD. Not single factor.
attribution_boundary.AR: Same available terminal information and requests; neither equal actual compute nor tuning adequacy established.

costs.scope: Ledger totals include earlier smoke/entry failure/maturity/recovery, not only128 four-arm completed requests. Nested timings not added; original CE total remains unknown. Diagnostic descriptions in ledger are not evidence for this review.

scientific_limits: One fitted seed per arm; generated requests are not independent training replicates.
Reused development41 and stage-adaptive engineering/recovery opportunities; no untouched holdout or significance claim.
Prior interrupted CE generation and extra recovery remain separate; old gates not backfilled.
Mean reconstruction and autonomous generation measure different tasks.
Standard CE/J repair is not a novelty claim.
Unknown wetlab N/conflicts remain unresolved; old wetlab is not prospective H5 evidence.
No biological activity, safety, general superiority, publication readiness or remote backup claim.
closeout_decision: Close current four-arm descriptive comparison with local reconstruction repair evidence and failed generation screen; do not promote complex pipeline superiority. New causal/source diagnostic, if separately contracted, cannot retroactively change these gates.
